label: Root-supply interface: variants into whole-roster nontrapping and one derivation from root existence
summary: Issue #1926 phase 2, slice 2a (root-supply interface). QUESTION: can the root-supply variants be registered into one interface 'an actual root exists' in the selected sense, and can a NecessaryClassicalGodRoot derive theorem be stated once against it, without identifying grounding, causing or priority? SENSE: the interface is the existing statement dc397705 (RootPositiveIntellectWill.ActualRootExistsAt): some actual concretum has no actual concrete ground in the profile's one selected relation grounds w (DEF-BRUTE-ROOT-RELATIVE-GROUNDING; the root may have a non-concrete or unmodelled explanation). Every variant and theorem here concerns that one relation m.grounds; no bridge to causing or priority is used. FINDING 1 (why variants cannot strengthen root existence directly): the variants (well-founded actual grounding 82cfaf26, finite rank 47e323f2, the all-subsets borrowing cut e27ea8e3, closed collections rooted aca3baa1, graded grounding 4fe25134) are stated without population and mostly without excluded middle, so none entails root existence alone: an empty world satisfies each and has no root. What they entail constructively is whole-roster nontrapping 5c898d24 (41 consuming arguments). PROVED (zero axioms, no excluded middle): whole-roster nontrapping is equivalent to 'if the actual roster is inhabited, it is not the case that no actual root exists' (wholeRosterIsInhabitedRootNotAbsent), so it is the population-conditional, double-negated form of the interface. REGISTERED: (a) root existence strengthens whole-roster nontrapping (wholeRosterOfActualRootExists), with a certified difference: root existence iff nontrapping, population and stability of root existence (rootExistsOverWholeRosterExact, constructive; under excluded middle the difference is population alone, matching WholeRosterRootEquivalenceAt). (b) Well-founded actual grounding strengthens whole-roster nontrapping (wholeRosterOfActualGroundingWF, accessibility induction, constructive); with the existing order finite rank to well-founded (6f632c38) this also brings finite rank. (c) The all-subsets borrowing cut strengthens whole-roster nontrapping, backed by the existing result WHOLE-ROSTER-FROM-CUT (88ac9b2a). (d) The source-backed supply premise e95c2bab is logically equivalent to root existence (existing result CONCRETE-SUPPLY-ROOT-EQUIVALENCE, 89605d34). NO CERTIFIED DIFFERENCE for (b): a delta must give back well-foundedness from nontrapping, and the known route builds the trap of inaccessible actual concreta, which needs not-all-accessible to some-inaccessible (excluded middle); classical candidate: under excluded middle, well-foundedness iff nontrapping and every nonempty trap is the whole roster. Not shown unavoidable. For (c) a constructive delta IS available, not yet certified: every nonempty non-trap escapes and every nonempty trap is the whole roster (borrowingCutFactorsThroughWholeRoster, zero axioms, Comparator-checked in the certificate result). An earlier draft wrongly said (c) had no delta for the same reason as (b). Given population, the stability conjunct of (a)'s difference is constructively the implication from nontrapping to root existence (stabilityIsRootImplicationGivenPopulation), so (a)'s substantive difference is population. FINDING 2 (derive against the interface): deriveFromActualRoot proves the quarta-via classical GOD_4 root (da3facd6) from root existence, contingent grounding, excluded middle and the 21 shared inputs of NecessaryClassicalGodRoot.derive (population and nontrapping follow from the root); zero axioms, checked by Comparator in the configuration of result 'Whole-roster nontrapping from an actual root'. BLOCKED as a corpus argument: its premise bundle repeats the base route 3a56507d's allowlisted mixing of POTENCY_CAPACITY_AND_POWER_ACROSS_ADOPTED. Premise a4d3261a (act simply prior to potency) links DEF-POTENCY (adopted: capacity and not in act) and c6d6379b (not act and potency in the same respect) links DEF-INDEPENDENT-POTENCY, while both bind the same Lean parameter InPotency of the generic derivation. The sense allowlist may only shrink, so a new argument needs a genuine bridge or a corrected tag (per DISAMB 508617ab the generic Challenges retain DEF-INDEPENDENT-POTENCY, so a4d3261a's tag is the likely mis-tag). The GOD_1/GOD_4 and NECESSARY_11/NECESSARY_2 mixings of the same bundle were bridged by the precedents of the at-first and closed-roots specs. COMPUTED EFFECT: whole-roster nontrapping gains one non-circular support option, well-founded actual grounding 82cfaf26. The option from root existence dc397705 is circular in the current corpus: dc397705's only derivation 6560ccfa (assembly transcription 9f7c8201) consumes 5c898d24 with population and excluded middle, so it adds no warrant. The route-cost drops 52 to 50 (1deb1d29) and 53 to 51 (3357fa30) arise because --routes cannot expand a transcription, so dc397705 stands as one proved_unestablished leaf in place of the three potential-gap premises: a packing artifact of the phase-4 kind; route expansion does not apply the support-cycle set-aside of the 2026-11-12 strength-registration decision (docs/notes/cheapest-route-packing.md, second instance). OUTCOME: presentational duplicates factored, partially; no proof-body consolidation; no new bridge. REMAINING: NecessaryConcreteUnderivedAt 0bdcf366 strengthens root existence (the interface of the at-first, by-composition and from-underived routes; existential-witness delta obstacle as in phase 0); closed collections rooted, graded grounding, cone and thinker well-foundedness (local, need a selected actual concretum), asymmetry (needs the maximum-in-being premises); a separator model for (b); the POTENCY tag repair, after which deriveFromActualRoot can be registered.
